Position Title:
Research Scientist I 
 
 Job Group:
Professional & Scientific 
 
 Required Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree 
 
 Job Description:
 The Department of Chemistry in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Iowa State University (ISU) is seeking a Research Scientist I. This position will conceive, design, and conduct research studies, as well as develop and implement software focused on laboratory automation and orchestration. The position will collaborate with the supervisor and other principal investigators (PIs) at Iowa State University, Ames National Laboratory, and external institutions.
  
 The successful candidate will possess strong communication skills to effectively interact with experienced colleagues in interdisciplinary fields for successful collaboration on research projects. The ability to timely plan, initiate, and execute research activities is important for success in this position. In addition, the successful candidate may mentor other researchers in the supervisor’s work groups and prepare reports as necessary.
   
 This is a 10-month term appointment, with the possibility of renewal based on funding availability. 
  
 Examples of Duties: 
 Design, develop, and implement modular, reusable, accessible, and extensible software solutions for laboratory automation and orchestration.
 Plan and coordinate research activities, establish project milestones, and develop implementation plans in collaboration with supervisors and project leads.
 Collaborate with internal and external scientists to develop methods, algorithms, and software solutions aligned with project needs.
 Conduct research investigations, collect and analyze data, interpret findings, and prepare technical and scientific reports.
 Present and communicate research findings at professional and project meetings and contribute to manuscripts for publication.
 Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to students and researchers in software engineering and research methodologies.
 Provide scientific expertise, collaboration, and consultation to researchers and project partners within the area of specialization.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience developing accessible, open-source laboratory automation software, orchestration frameworks, 3D printer software, and autonomous robotic control and coordination.
 Proficiency in Python, LabVIEW, GUI development, and software design patterns, with experience with developing technical software documentation and tutorials using tools such as Sphinx.
 Experience integrating laboratory devices through hardware/software interfaces, communication protocols, drivers, and technologies such as SiLA2, gRPC, RS-232, RS-485, USB, serial, and Ethernet.
 Experience with collaborative software development tools and workflows, including Git, GitHub, and automated build tools.
 Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including experimental scientists.
 
 Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis without sponsorship. Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position. 

 Application Instructions: 
To apply for this position, please click on “Apply” and complete the Employment Application. Please be prepared to enter or attach the following:
 Resume/Curriculum Vitae
 Letter of Application/Cover Letter
 
 Why Choose Iowa State University? 
Iowa State Employees enjoy comprehensive health and work-life benefits, including medical and dental, as well as:
 Retirement benefits including defined benefit and defined contribution plans
 Generous vacation, holiday, and sick time and leave plans
 Onsite childcare (Ames, Iowa)
 Life insurance and long-term disability
 Flexible Spending Accounts
 Various voluntary benefits and discounts
 Employee Assistance Program
 Wellbeing program

 If you have questions regarding this application process, please email employment@iastate.edu, or call 515-294-4800 or Toll Free: 1-877-477-7485.
